primitives.name: Full Text Accessibility Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: If the full text is genuinely inaccessible (withdrawn, no ar5iv HTML, PDF unparseable), record the paper as BLOCKED in the manifest with the exact reason — do NOT write a ledger from the abstract.
primitives.assumptions: Full-text accessibility is a binary condition; abstract-only ledgers are invalid for 500-paper count.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When {ar5iv_html, pdf} are unavailable and fallbacks fail.

layer2.mapping: The status transition function mirrors GSI's belief update on data availability.
layer2.telemetry: Number of BLOCKED papers per manifest batch.

primitives.name: Ledger Completeness Validator
primitives.verbatim_quote: A paper counts toward the 500 ONLY when its full ledger is complete and verified.
primitives.assumptions: Completeness implies all required sections are filled; verification requires peer review or internal audit.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When any required section is missing or unverified.

layer2.mapping: Ledger completeness is a derived kernel of GSE's data integration pipeline.
layer2.telemetry: Proportion of verified vs total processed papers.

primitives.name: Data Schema Specification
primitives.verbatim_quote: Dataset / schema Every dataset used: name, size (rows/periods), time range, schema (key columns), access (public URL / request / proprietary).
primitives.assumptions: All datasets are fully described with schema and access details.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When dataset description is incomplete or ambiguous.

layer2.mapping: Schema specification aligns with GSE’s data ingestion layer abstraction.
layer2.telemetry: Schema coverage ratio across all datasets in ledger.
